items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation of the police report even though the report is required. The conditional estimate is 2 hours × €80.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the translator’s working materials and any disbursements billed alongside the excluded translation. The conditional estimate is €10 for the single charge.

Clause 7.1.9 excludes the upgrade premium, and clauses 4.2.2 and 4.4 cap the equivalent watch at €2,500. The watch receives €125 of the single €150 event deductible under 7.5 and 7.8, allocated pro rata across the €3,000 covered loss.

Clauses 2.3.2 and 4.2.3 cap the roughly €900 in stolen cash at €500; the €5,000 away-from-home aggregate does not bind. The cash receives €25 of the single €150 event deductible on a pro rata basis, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery, so clauses 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude them. The conditional estimate is €250 for one pair.
Clauses 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude forwarding and delivery charges, even on a settlement that includes covered property. The conditional estimate is €26 for one shipment.
